title: Activities overview
description: GNOME desktop: open the Activities overview to search and switch tasks; Super is the key often labeled Windows. Ubuntu GNOME assignments can be changed in Settings > Keyboard > View and Customize Shortcuts.

title: Show all applications
description: GNOME desktop: show the applications grid. Change the binding in Settings > Keyboard > View and Customize Shortcuts.

title: Switch applications
description: GNOME desktop: cycle through applications; the standard assignment may be customized in Keyboard settings.

title: Switch windows directly
description: GNOME desktop: cycle directly through open windows. This Ubuntu assignment can be customized; check Keyboard settings if it differs.

title: Switch windows of an app
description: GNOME desktop: switch between windows belonging to an application; available binding may vary with settings.

title: Switch system controls
description: GNOME desktop: move focus between system interface controls; customize through Keyboard settings.

title: Previous workspace
description: GNOME desktop: move to the workspace on the left. Workspace availability and bindings depend on GNOME configuration.

title: Next workspace
description: GNOME desktop: move to the workspace on the right. Workspace availability and bindings depend on GNOME configuration.

title: Switch to last workspace
description: GNOME desktop: switch to the last workspace; the shortcut can be changed in Keyboard settings.

title: Switch to workspace one
description: GNOME desktop: switch to workspace one. This assignment is customizable and some workspace shortcuts may be disabled by default.

title: Move window to workspace left
description: GNOME desktop: send the focused window to the workspace on the left; requires multiple workspaces.

title: Move window to workspace right
description: GNOME desktop: send the focused window to the workspace on the right; requires multiple workspaces.

title: Move window to workspace one
description: GNOME desktop: move the focused window to workspace one; workspace shortcuts are configurable.

title: Move window to monitor right
description: GNOME desktop: move focused window to the monitor on the right; meaningful on a multi-monitor setup.

title: Move window to monitor left
description: GNOME desktop: move focused window to the monitor on the left; meaningful on a multi-monitor setup.

title: Lock screen
description: GNOME desktop: lock the session; unlock requires your configured authentication.

title: Show system menu
description: GNOME desktop: open the system status menu for settings and session controls.

title: Show notification list
description: GNOME desktop: open the notification list; availability of notifications depends on session state.

title: Focus active notification
description: GNOME desktop: focus an active notification when one is present.

title: Show run command prompt
description: GNOME desktop: open the run-command prompt to launch an application or command.

title: Close window
description: GNOME desktop: close the focused window; applications may ask to save unsaved work.

title: Maximize window
description: GNOME desktop: maximize the focused window; use Restore to return it to its prior size.

title: Restore window
description: GNOME desktop: restore the focused window from maximized state.

title: Toggle maximization
description: GNOME desktop: toggle maximized state of the focused window.

title: Tile window left
description: GNOME desktop: snap the focused window to the left side of the display.

title: Tile window right
description: GNOME desktop: snap the focused window to the right side of the display.

title: Open window menu
description: GNOME desktop: open the focused window's menu for window actions.

title: Move focused window
description: GNOME desktop: enter window-move mode; use pointer or arrow keys to reposition, then confirm. Configurable in Keyboard settings.

title: Resize focused window
description: GNOME desktop: enter window-resize mode; use pointer or arrow keys, then confirm. Configurable in Keyboard settings.

title: Open screenshot tool
description: GNOME desktop: open screenshot controls for choosing a screen, window, or area.

title: Screenshot window
description: GNOME desktop: save a screenshot of a window; captured window depends on desktop focus and screenshot implementation.

title: Screenshot entire screen
description: GNOME desktop: save a screenshot of the entire screen.

title: Record short screencast
description: GNOME desktop: start or stop a short screen recording; recording support and save location depend on the installed GNOME version.

title: Toggle screen zoom
description: GNOME desktop: toggle magnification. Accessibility bindings can be changed or may be disabled in Keyboard settings.

title: Zoom in
description: GNOME desktop: increase screen magnification; depends on accessibility zoom being available.

title: Zoom out
description: GNOME desktop: decrease screen magnification; depends on accessibility zoom being available.

title: Toggle screen reader
description: GNOME desktop: toggle the screen reader; accessibility shortcut can be changed in Keyboard settings.

title: Next input source
description: GNOME desktop: switch to the next configured keyboard input source; requires multiple input sources.

title: Previous input source
description: GNOME desktop: switch to the previous configured keyboard input source; requires multiple input sources.

title: Show power-off dialog
description: GNOME desktop: open the system power-off dialog; system behavior may depend on the current session.

title: Move cursor left
description: Bash terminal: move one character left in the current command line using Readline emacs-style editing (the usual default); bindings can be changed in ~/.inputrc.

title: Move cursor right
description: Bash terminal: move one character right in the current command line; Readline keymaps and bindings are configurable.

title: Move to line start
description: Bash terminal: move to the start of the editable command line.

title: Move to line end
description: Bash terminal: move to the end of the editable command line.

title: Move forward one word
description: Bash terminal: move forward by a Readline word (letters and digits); Meta is commonly Alt, but terminal settings may differ.

title: Move backward one word
description: Bash terminal: move backward by a Readline word; Meta is commonly Alt, but terminal settings may differ.

title: Delete character under cursor
description: Bash terminal: delete the character at the cursor. At an empty line, Ctrl+D may instead signal end-of-input/EOF.

title: Delete character before cursor
description: Bash terminal: erase the character to the left of the cursor; Backspace behavior can vary with terminal configuration.

title: Delete to line end
description: Bash terminal: remove text from cursor through the end of the command line; the text is available to Readline's kill/yank mechanism.

title: Delete to line start
description: Bash terminal: remove text from cursor back to the start of the command line.

title: Delete next word
description: Bash terminal: remove from cursor through the end of the current or next word.

title: Delete previous word
description: Bash terminal: remove the word behind the cursor; exact word boundary behavior is Readline-defined.

title: Delete previous whitespace-delimited word
description: Bash terminal: kill the word behind the cursor using whitespace as the boundary; text can be restored with yank.

title: Yank last killed text
description: Bash terminal: insert the most recently killed text at the cursor from Readline's kill ring.

title: Cycle kill ring
description: Bash terminal: replace the preceding yank with another kill-ring entry; works only immediately after yank or yank-pop.

title: Previous command in history
description: Bash terminal: recall the previous command from history; arrow-up may also be bound to this action.

title: Next command in history
description: Bash terminal: move forward through history toward the current line; arrow-down may also be bound to this action.

title: Reverse search history
description: Bash terminal: incrementally search backward through command history; press Ctrl+R again to find earlier matches.

title: Forward search history
description: Bash terminal: incrementally search forward through command history; some terminal configurations intercept this control key.

title: Insert previous command's last argument
description: Bash terminal: insert the last argument of the prior history entry; repeated presses cycle through earlier entries. Meta is commonly Alt.

title: Clear terminal display
description: Bash terminal: clear the display and redraw the current command line at the top; does not clear command history.

title: Accept command line
description: Bash terminal: submit the current input line for execution regardless of cursor position; command execution follows normal shell rules.

title: Undo last line edit
description: Bash terminal: undo the last Readline editing command; repeated undo can return the line to empty. Default binding can vary by configuration.

title: Transpose adjacent characters
description: Bash terminal: swap the character before the cursor with the one at the cursor; at line end, swaps the final two characters.
